HUNT-RSSI-SNAPSHOT-FOCUS-R3
# PR #215 R3: fix live HUNT 0% flicker AND slow return to zero.
# Root cause: frame captures millis() at loop start, NimBLE callback can
# update lastSeenMs afterwards; unsigned now - lastSeenMs underflows and
# instantly makes a live signal look expired. R1/R2 timer increases only
# hid this bug and made signal-off detection unacceptably slow.
# R3: signed wrap-safe age comparison, fresh millis at HUNT render.
# R3: HUNT RSSI history/count/timestamp read as one protected snapshot;
# NimBLE writer and HUNT target modifications use one portMUX.
# R3: on WiFi HUNT, stay on the observed BSSID's channel while receiving,
# resume normal channel sweep after 2s silence to reacquire channel changes.
# New loss windows: BLE 4.0s; WiFi 6.5s, instead of BLE 9/WiFi 15s.
# Current RSSI changes as each radio sample arrives; do NOT ease into 0.
# Confirmed lost: 0% / NO SIGNAL, not last held dBm and never 0 dBm.
# One serial [hunt-rssi] diagnostic only on live/absent transitions
# (radio, age, count, channel; never logs MAC or private details).
# Native tests cover time inversion, callback-before-render race, packet
# gaps, channel focus/release, true OFF, reacquisition and millis rollover.
# LAB builds for CYD2.8 ST7789 + CYD3.2 ST7798, no production tag/release.
# Preserve original PR #214 and other LAB branches. DO NOT MERGE.
